concurrency.description: Maximum number of live workers. Serial by default.

schedulerIntervalMs.description: How often queued work is admitted.

reconcileIntervalMs.description: How often live workers are reconciled against the harnesses.

stallAfterMinutes.description: A busy worker with no activity for this long gets an inspection request. Workers are never killed.

stallRealertMinutes.description: At most one stall alert per task per window.

attentionExpiryMinutes.description: Unanswered permission requests and questions expire and are denied; they are never replayed.

digestWindowMs.description: Notifications raised within this many milliseconds of the first one are sent as one digest ("4 ready for review, 1 needs you"). 0 sends on the next outbox pass without waiting.

focusApp.description: Terminal app to bring forward when a notification is clicked: its bundle id (com.mitchellh.ghostty) or window class (kitty). Detected from tmux by default.

workerIdleMinutes.description: Worker processes the supervisor owns stop after this long idle; their sessions resume on the next instruction.

enabled.description: Offer OpenCode workers (profiles with harness opencode) and wake the manager through the OpenCode service.

serviceFile.description: OpenCode service registration file; defaults to OpenCode's own discovery path.

enabled.description: Offer Claude Code workers (profiles with harness claude). Off by default; when off, claude is never run and dispatches to its profiles are refused. Restart to apply.

binary.description: Absolute path of the claude binary; defaults to a lookup on the PATH your login shell sets up.

enabled.description: Offer Codex workers (profiles with harness codex). Off by default; when off, codex is never run and dispatches to its profiles are refused. Restart to apply.

binary.description: Absolute path of the codex binary; defaults to a lookup on the PATH your login shell sets up.

enabled.description: Open and merge pull requests with the GitHub CLI (gh, logged in with `gh auth login`): ocd task pr / merge and the manager's PR tools. Off by default; when off, gh is never run. Restart to apply.

Use tmux: a notification click (ocd focus) switches to the manager's tmux pane and raises its terminal, and a taken-over session opens in its own tmux window when the TUI runs in tmux. Off by default; when off, tmux is never run. `ocd focus` reads this on every call; the taken-over-session window needs a restart to apply.

allowFakeHarness.description: Allow profiles that use the fake harness (tests and dry runs).

intervalHours.description: Hours between automatic database backups; 0 disables them.

keep.description: Number of automatic backups to keep in ~/.ocd/backups.

branchSync.description: The branch-sync watchdog: keeps task branches near their repository's baseRef to reduce drift. Off by default.

mode.description: off: nothing runs. detect: read-only; tasks show how far their branch is behind the repo's baseRef and whether merging it would conflict. refresh: detect, and also fast-forward or merge the baseRef into clean, idle task branches at safe boundaries (never pushes, rebases, stashes or resolves conflicts). Per repo: repos.<name>.branchSync. Applies on save. See docs/branch-sync.md.

intervalMs.description: How often task branches are compared with their base (restart to apply).

maxTasksPerTick.description: At most this many tasks are checked per interval, least recently checked first.

selfUpdate.description: Keeping OCD itself up to date from its own repository.

enabled.description: OCD updates itself: new commits on the repository's branch are built into ~/.ocd/install, smoke-tested, and switched to by restarting the background service once no worker that a restart would interrupt is running. Off by default. Restart to apply.

repo.description: The declared repository (under repos) that holds OCD's own source. Ignored when path is set.

path.description: A checkout of OCD's own repository to follow instead of a declared repo (`~` is expanded), so a machine that only uses OCD need not dispatch work to it. `ocd setup` sets it.

branch.description: Branch to follow on origin; defaults to the remote's default branch.

intervalMinutes.description: How often origin is checked for a new version (also right after a task lands in that repository).

build.description: Shell commands that build a checkout, run in order in the new build directory.

enabled.description: Remove the worktrees of finished (accepted or cancelled) tasks after afterHours, the way `ocd task cleanup` does: never forced, so a worktree whose work would be lost is kept. Off by default.

afterHours.description: How long a finished task's worktree is kept before automatic cleanup.

usageLimits.description: Tracking the subscription usage limits the harnesses report. Restart to apply.

notifyAt.description: Percentages of a subscription usage window (5-hour, weekly, ...) that send a notification, once per window. [] turns these notifications off; reaching a limit is always reported.

pollMinutes.description: How often limits are read, for the harnesses that can be read without a model call (no tokens). 0 reads them only from running workers; other harnesses report them only while a worker runs.

mergeMethod.description: How work lands in its base branch, through a pull request or a direct push: squash (one commit), merge (a merge commit) or rebase (the task's commits replayed). Per repo: repos.<name>.mergeMethod. Applies on save.

manager.description: The manager: sessions in this directory act as manager, and the most recently used one receives updates.

directory.description: Working directory of the manager. OpenCode sessions started here may use the ocd_* tools; `~` is expanded.

repos.description: Repositories the manager may dispatch to. The key is the repository name. Saved changes apply automatically.

path.description: Repository root. `~` is expanded; symlinks are resolved.

profile.description: Default profile for tasks in this repository; must be declared under profiles.

baseRef.description: Ref new task branches start from. Defaults to the repository's current HEAD.

mergeMethod.description: How this repository's work lands (pull request merges and direct pushes); defaults to the top-level mergeMethod.

branchSync.description: Branch-sync mode for this repository's tasks, overriding branchSync.mode. Tracks baseRef, which must be set. See docs/branch-sync.md.

profiles.description: Named execution profiles. The key is the name used in dispatches and repo defaults. Saved changes apply automatically.

harness.description: Harness that runs the worker: one of the harnesses OCD knows (listed here by the schema).

model.description: Model id as the harness spells it, optionally with a #variant suffix (`ocd doctor` checks it against the harness's own model list).

description.description: When to use this profile. Shown to the manager, which picks profiles by name.

agent.description: Harness agent preset, for harnesses that have them.

instructions.description: Standing guidance added to every worker prompt using this profile.

permissionPolicy.description: ask: permission requests go to the human. deny: they are rejected and recorded. allow: each request is approved once, automatically, and recorded. yolo: the harness skips its permission checks and sandbox entirely (its own most permissive mode; see the README's permissions section); nothing is asked or recorded.

envAllowlist.description: Environment variables passed to the worker in addition to a minimal base set (PATH, HOME, ...).
